css.camera
format:
<style>

#camera_layout { background-image: url("data:{{msg.mime}},{{msg.payload}}"); 
    background-repeat: no-repeat; 
    background-size: contain;
    background-position: center;
}
#camera_layout md-card { background-color:transparent; overflow:hidden; border:dashed 0px goldenrod; opacity: 100 !important; }
.nr-dashboard-spacer { opacity: 100 !important; }

#camera_header { border:none; background-color:transparent; }
#camera_header md-card { background-color:transparent; overflow:hidden; border:dashed 0px goldenrod; opacity: 100 !important; }

#camera_header md-select .md-select-icon { display:none; }
#camera_header md-select .md-select-value { border:none; padding:0px;margin:0px; margin-top:16px; color:#808080; }

#camera_header md-input-container { }

#camera_footer { border:none; background-color:transparent; }
#camera_footer md-card { background-color:transparent; overflow:hidden; border:dashed 0px goldenrod; opacity: 100 !important; }

[data-title]:hover:after { opacity: 1; transition: all 0.1s ease 0.5s; visibility: visible; }
[data-title]:after {
content: attr(data-title);
background-color: #888; color: whitesmoke; font-size: 12px; font-weight:bold; 
position: absolute; 
padding: 8px; bottom: 0; 
right: 100%; 
white-space: nowrap; 
opacity: 0; 
z-index: 9999; 
visibility: hidden; 
float: right; 
width: fit-content; 
line-height: 12px; 
border-radius: 4px;
}
[data-title] { position: relative; }

.camera-label p.value { font-weight:normal; font-size: 90%; color:gray; }

</style>
